text:
You need a reliable way to replace the current multi-sheet action flow with direct AppSheet API updates into your Google Sheet data source.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’ve spent 5 years working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’ve built a repeatable readout template for in-app store experiments with power checks before launch for Hearthstone Games, which covered 11 experiments and stopped 2 underpowered tests early. I also built a scheduled KPI pack for Alder Property Group in Google Sheets/BigQuery/Looker Studio that tracked 22 KPIs and saved about 5 hours a week.  

I can work with HTTP-based requests in Python or JavaScript, handle PATCH updates, and build in error handling for accuracy and reliability. I’m ready to start immediately and can join the video call to map the current flow. What format is your Google Sheet data source currently using for the rows that need to be updated via the AppSheet API?
